SELECT s.id sku_id,s.factory_id,f.factory_name, (s.sku_status='online' AND f.factory_status='active' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prop_sku_audit a WHERE a.sku_id=s.id AND a.audit_status='pending')) public_visible FROM prop_sku s JOIN factory_profile f ON f.id=s.factory_id WHERE s.id IN #{id}
